body:
Awesome! Do you feel like writing a tutorial that we would publish on our [blog](https://blog.algolia.com/)? This seems to be like one of the most advanced usages of instantsearch.js that we did. Contact me at vincent@algolia.com if interested.

> Obviously it triggers a lot of queries/renders though so not sure how performant it will be.

Yes indeed that's why I proposed a solution where only the count is updated, not all the widgets. And then only update the whole interface when switching tabs. That's still feasible.

We might have to re-think about this usecase once we have more feedback from you to see what could be done.

> The only outstanding issue is that the searchbox is not updating when the query changes. Is there a way to trigger a re-render or manually set it?

Yes this is a known issue that I fixed yesterday, should be released soon (see #886)

In the meantime you can update the value of the input manually with DOM:

``` js
document.querySelector('#search-box input').value = ..;
helper.setQuery(..).search();
```

Does that makes sense?
